# Colour palette
pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("#2E7D9E", "#C05C28"),
  domain  = c("Bactrocera dorsalis", "Ceratitis capitata")
)

# Popup HTML
institutions <- institutions |>
  mutate(popup = paste0(
    "<div style='font-family:sans-serif;min-width:220px;max-width:280px'>",
    "<div style='font-weight:700;font-size:0.95rem;margin-bottom:4px'>",
    name, "</div>",
    "<div style='color:#555;font-size:0.82rem;margin-bottom:6px'>", institution, "</div>",
    "<hr style='margin:6px 0;border-color:#ddd'>",
    "<div style='margin-bottom:4px'>",
    "<span style='background:", pal(species), ";color:#fff;",
    "border-radius:4px;padding:2px 7px;font-size:0.75rem;font-style:italic'>",
    species, "</span></div>",
    "<div style='font-size:0.8rem;margin-top:6px'>",
    "<b>Research themes</b><br>",
    gsub(" · ", "<br>· ", themes),
    "</div>",
    "<div style='font-size:0.8rem;margin-top:6px'>",
    "<b>Key researchers</b><br>",
    gsub(" · ", "<br>· ", researchers),
    "</div>",
    "<div style='font-size:0.78rem;color:#777;margin-top:6px'>",
    papers, " paper", ifelse(papers == 1, "", "s"), " in database (2026)",
    "</div>",
    "</div>"
  ))

leaflet(institutions,
        options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 2, maxZoom = 10)) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng        = ~lon,
    lat        = ~lat,
    radius     = ~scales::rescale(papers, to = c(7, 20)),
    color      = ~pal(species),
    fillColor  = ~pal(species),
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    weight     = 2,
    opacity    = 1,
    popup      = ~popup,
    label      = ~name,
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style     = list("font-weight" = "bold", padding = "4px 8px"),
      textsize  = "13px",
      direction = "auto"
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft",
    pal      = pal,
    values   = ~species,
    title    = "Species",
    opacity  = 0.85,
    labFormat = labelFormat(transform = function(x) paste0("<em>", x, "</em>"))
  ) |>
  addControl(
    html = paste0(
      "<div style='background:#fff;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:6px;",
      "border:1px solid #ccc;font-family:sans-serif;font-size:0.78rem;color:#555'>",
      "<b>Bubble size</b> = number of 2026 papers<br>",
      "<b>Click</b> a bubble to see researchers and themes",
      "</div>"
    ),
    position = "topright"
  ) |>
  setView(lng = 30, lat = 30, zoom = 2)
